ops.title: yasyf box sweep 2026-07-25: corrected synckit diagnosis (stale state.json + rpc-serve contract), debris inventory, fusekit WIP safe-ish
ops.body:
The yBook-Pro sweep (90-second wake window, read-only) CORRECTS the earlier briefing on two points:

**1. Reconcile is NOT dying on a foreign `backend` field.** Its only error: `state.json schema mismatch; manually recreate exact schema v1 state: envelope: keys do not exactly match [schema host_registry synckit]`. The direction is opposite to assumed: `~/.config/synckit/state.json` is STALE (mtime Jul 3, old two-key `{hosts, self}` shape with hosts yasyf-home + self yasyf) and installed synckitd 0.35.2 outgrew it. Repair = recreate state.json in the exact v1 envelope (read the shape from the deployed synckitd's source; preserve both hosts). LIKELY APPLIES TO yasyf-home TOO once its synckitd 0.23.0 is upgraded — add state.json recreation to both machines' repair recipes.

**2. The handshake loop's root cause is a version/manifest contract mismatch, not wire/trust.** Manifests (cc-pool.json rewritten mid-swarm Jul 20, incl. a harmless `watch.backend: fsnotify` field that parses fine) tell synckitd to spawn `<binary> sync rpc-serve`; installed reposync 0.27.3 has no such subcommand (`reposync: unknown command "rpc-serve"` in the child stderr) → child exits → socket EOF → `wire: handshake failed: read acknowledge: EOF`. Same signature as yasyf-home's cookiesync. The loop dates to Jun 27 (20,231 failures, live at ~5s retry). Fix belongs to the A4/A5 repin/release wave: ship reposync/cc-pool exposing `sync rpc-serve`, then upgrade. Note: cc-pool has TWO brew versions installed simultaneously (HEAD-06621a7 + 0.61.7) — resolve the dual install during repair; it may decide which binary synckitd resolves.

**Other facts**: box rebooted Jul 19 mid-swarm, up 6 days since — nothing cleared. Wedged daemonkit-worker PID 4829 still burning a core (43h CPU; cmdline = TestPrepareAccountBackingDeadlineKillsReapsAndUntracks leftover — live evidence for the claude-pool kill/reap-path investigation; capture `sample` forensics before killing). Also alive: SwiftPM BrokerHandoffTests bundle (59818), a Tue codex CLI with bypass flags (47597/47585), 12 plan-mode Claude sessions since Jul 19. Fish driver loop NOT running — swarm dormant. captain-hook there is 12.20.2 (briefing's 10.5.0 was wrong); cc-orchestrate 0.5.1 stale. synckitd log timestamps skewed +19h (TZ env bug — fix during repair). agent/* bookmarks fleet-wide ≈183 (fusekit 76, claude-pool 39, daemonkit 20).

**fusekit WIP**: 70 dirty files (+4535/−2711), ONE coherent catalog/transport reshape across Swift+Go; base commit 12d6cedb IS pushed (origin/agent/catalog-core-v1, repo on detached HEAD there) — only the working tree is at risk. Generated files (messages_gen.go, CatalogProtocol.generated.swift) should be regenerated, not hand-salvaged. Staged-vs-unstaged split unreliable (sweep used --no-optional-locks); settle with plain git status at mutation time. User verdict pending on salvage/discard.
